description:
Research and expand ReqLlmNext Anthropic support beyond the current curated Messages lane.

Goals:
- map the official Anthropic API and tool surface against the v2 execution-plan architecture
- keep the common Messages path simple and declarative
- isolate Anthropic-specific edge cases into narrow surfaces, policy, or adapters
- add replay-first and targeted live verification for each new surface

Scope includes: native structured outputs, citations/search results, Files API, token counting, message batches, server tools, context editing/compaction, MCP connector, computer use, and the OpenAI-compat layer.
